description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance of three different language models under four distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the models "LLaMA-2-7B", "LLaMA-2-13B", and "LLaMA-2-70B", ordered sequentially by model size. The vertical axis is the value axis, labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", featuring a linear scale ranging from 0 to over 80, with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 10. The chart uses grouped vertical bars, with four bars per model category corresponding to the conditions listed in the legend located in the bottom right corner. These conditions are visually distinguished as follows: "no SFT" is light blue with downward diagonal white hatching, "+ SFT on $D_0$" is light orange with horizontal white hatching, "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" is light purple with upward diagonal white hatching, and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" is solid light pink. For LLaMA-2-7B, the values start at approximately 66% for both "no SFT" and "+ SFT on $D_0$" (representing the shortest bars in the chart), rising to roughly 81% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" and peaking at about 84% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". For LLaMA-2-13B, the "no SFT" bar is near 70%, "+ SFT on $D_0$" is near 74%, "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" reaches the highest overall value in the chart at approximately 85%, and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" is around 80%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the bars show less variation, with "no SFT" at roughly 81%, "+ SFT on $D_0$" at 82%, "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" at 84%, and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" at 83%. The categories on the horizontal axis are ordered by model size, and the grouped bars follow the sequential order of the legend, with visual emphasis applied through distinct white hatching patterns on the first three bars of each group contrasting with the solid fill of the final bar.
